card.name: Lobo de Guerra Negro como Azeviche
card.summary: O oponente não pode ativar Cards de Armadilha durante a Fase de Batalha de qualquer jogador.

textEvidence.text: This monster has one continuous effect while it is face-up in a Monster Zone and its effects are not negated: its controller's opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during either player's Battle Phase. This is a restriction on new card activations, not effect negation. It does not negate any already activated card or effect and does not restrict effects of already face-up cards or effects activated in the Graveyard. Its controller can still activate those card kinds. The restriction follows current control, ends immediately when the source leaves the field, becomes face-down or is negated, and multiple sources apply independently. No activation, cost, target, choice or secondary effect exists.
